decisions.reason: As a more generic construction dumper in a competitive segment, it appears less differentiated from the firm's core safety-focused specialist niches, so if results are merely mediocre management would likely reallocate resources.

The inclined furniture lift fits the firm's lifting and service capabilities well enough that, absent clear signs of failure, boundedly rational management would likely continue it while learning more about demand.
The inclined building material lift is closely aligned with the firm's construction, lifting and material-handling strengths, making satisfactory performance and continued support more plausible.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is adjacent to the firm's capabilities but is a narrower and more resource-demanding variant, so if it has not clearly met aspirations management would be somewhat more likely to prune it.
